rows.46:9790:
"Don't make such a pathetic face."
"Let's all get along, shall we?"
"We'll always be watching over you."
"That's right, forever."
"Even after you grow up."
"Even when you meet someone and get married."
"Even when you have children and you're working for their sake."
"Even when you grow old someday and your children leave the nest."
"That's right, until the day you die."
"We'll be together forever."
"We'll watch over you."
"We'll watch over you."
"We'll always be watching over you."{p}
rows.46:99b0:
"We like you, you know."
"And you like us too, right?"
"We told you about the seven wonders, didn't we?"
"You're never alone. Not ever."
"Aren't you happy? Come on, you're happy, right?"
"When you go out, we'll hide in the wrinkles of your clothes."
"We can hide in the toes of your shoes, or even in your hair."{p}
rows.46:a1b4:
At the same time, I felt a moment of dizziness.
And then everything I saw changed completely.{p}
rows.46:a300:
I was scared.
And my hatred for them was every bit as strong. I could hardly stand it.
Why is this happening to me?
What did I ever do?
I hate them.
Scum like this don't even deserve to live!
Just then, my eyes fell on one of their faces.
This man!
I know this one.{p}
rows.46:ae04:
"A first-year, and you nod off in the middle of a meeting?
You've got some nerve."
"I-I'm sorry..."
I stood up.
I could feel my face going red.
"It's fine. But in exchange, you'll be the one heading up our next project."
Hino laughed brightly.
He never acts high and mighty. He's a good senior.
But what next project?
"Um... what are we doing?"
Hino made a big show of answering my question.{p}
